outer_rules.execution: Original single child Popen.wait + original env/App fast/returned close + full finally release; outer parent Popen.wait separately required

sensor.normal_channel_count: 10 per control = five original channels at MID + END; key is normal_channel_records, not normal_records
sensor.normal_samples: mid/end -> base_ang_vel(3),projected_gravity(3),leg_pos(4),leg_vel(4),wheel_vel(2); retain original B4 sample dictionaries and all fields
sensor.actor35: controls[i].post_return.actor35_original_buffer: original END raw policy buffer; metadata before witness selection; no compute/getter or clean_policy comparison
sensor.pre_reset: Original bridge.pre terminated/truncated bool[80] and original B4 before_reset metadata; absent callback stays NOT_OBSERVED/None
sensor.reset: Original existing integer ID argument in full K0..80, original B4 callback clocks, RETURNED/RAISED/exception/provenance/state; no new reset/nonzero
sensor.pending_error_payload: Original B4 incomplete_current_control with owned_partial_control + b3_callback_provenance; no invented end_control/finish on error
sensor.initial_memory_scope: Original reset -> E3 placement/publish -> original compute once; same-tick cache reuse possible, clean0 UNKNOWN

roles.ENV_ROWS_WITNESS: Explicit original axis=0 N80 -> prebuilt witness IDs 0..7; caller-declared index binding, not independent index readback
roles.ENV_IDS_FULL: Full original integer reset argument K0..80; no env axis, never first8 or row-index inference
roles.TERMINAL_BOOL_FULL: Full original bool[80] flags; no cast/reduction/reconstruction
roles.QUEUE_GROUP_FULL: Full N80 group legs/wheels queue/command/selected original target; explicit original env axis=0

typed_envelope.values_after_materialize: Python bool/int/float/list at original tensor dtype, no float cast, no second clone; original_dtype retained even though JSON alone has no dtype
typed_envelope.adopted_C2_queue_ownership: UNCHANGED_C2_FREEZE_MEMORY_ALREADY_DETACH_CLONED; no extra clone/index/cast; metadata from owned clone is a source-code claim, not independent input readback
typed_envelope.unknown_tensor: Metadata-only status UNKNOWN with original shape/dtype/device; values='UNKNOWN'; not a typed envelope and not bare Tensor

C2.source_clock_split: event.tick/raw_stored_counter/clock_source/parent context remain original unvalidated C2 event clock; event.adoption_clock and envelope.source_clock are later outside-control stored adoption clocks, never substitutes
C2.setter_joint_ids: Retain original method/source/omitted or kwargs or positional[1]_UNQUALIFIED_SDK_SIGNATURE; tensor IDs have metadata-only UNKNOWN values, never ENV_IDS_FULL
C2.stored_stats_scope: Existing calls/formula_max_error/collect and term/asset identities only; no new target getter, SDK/DOF/pipeline/readback qualification

strict_native_dependency_order: Install complete C2; no reset hook
restore_and_export_order: complete original EX release only after all child waits
